name: TableBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of a table coral structure. The object displays the raw geometry of a wide, flat plate coral — a broad, low horizontal form with smooth curved upper and lower surfaces, irregular lobed margins, and several pointed projection elements rising from the top. Without any texture or material color, the clean white geometry reveals the large-scale flat plate topology and the curving wavy perimeter profile typical of table coral growth.
